manifest.name: DuRetrieval full pinned Chinese corpus
manifest.license: Not declared in the pinned MTEB card; local evaluation only, corpus is not redistributed by this project
manifest.scope: Complete source dev corpus; explicitly selected original dev queries. Not a blind production holdout. No length filtering or truncation.
manifest.limitations: Unjudged is not negative. Possible embedding training exposure. No independent multi-evidence or no-answer labels.

manifest.name: CMRC2018 dev known-source answer-span diagnostic
manifest.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 as declared by the source repository; corpus not redistributed
manifest.citation: Cui et al., A Span-Extraction Dataset for Chinese Machine Reading Comprehension, EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, https://aclanthology.org/D19-1600/
manifest.scope: Known original paragraph supplied through scope_document_id. Not official CMRC scoring, global retrieval, chapter-complete evidence or answer correctness. All dev questions retained; unavailable spans excluded only from span metrics.
manifest.offset_policy: Validate original offset; recover only an exact unique answer quote. Missing/ambiguous quotes or heading-only anchors are explicitly audited.

embedding_profile.query_prefix: 为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章：

du_first_phase.scope: offline checkpoint cache; not a published corpus

du_resume.scope: offline checkpoint cache; not a published corpus

cmrc.scope: offline checkpoint cache; not a published corpus

cache.note: Initial disk-full batch was not committed; resumed committed checkpoints. Encoder log release counters are observations, not a billing or exact per-input deduplication ledger.

process.scope: Owned local BGE, same model and one-slot encoder as baseline; no cloud/Judge.

old_vector.scope: Frozen baseline vectors and exact-cosine source-location replay. No new SQL score verification; baseline already has 2,000 full controls.
old_vector.quality_backend: scikit-learn exact cosine on exported production vectors

new_vector.scope: Same Q8 embedding inputs/vectors; scikit-learn exact cosine versus production PostgreSQL cosine/max document aggregation. Does not test Q8 versus original model weights or answer quality.
new_vector.quality_backend: scikit-learn exact cosine on exported production vectors

lexical.rank_verification: Every top-24 list equals the frozen full-corpus BM25S run
lexical.scope: Native BM25S scores and production aggregation, display excerpts omitted.

sql_controls.scope: Evenly spaced production PostgreSQL controls; remaining production fields are null, quality uses exact sklearn for both policies.
